To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Clothing Pressure of knittted underwear is related to fabric property.
the clothing pressure of knitted underwear is negatively correlated with the elastic recovery rate of the knitted fabric.
the Clothing pressure of knitted underwear is related with fabric property of elastic recovery rate and tensile stretch rate of knitted underwear fabric.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the fabric property of knitted underwear and clothing pressure.
fabric property, Clothing Pressure and comfort of knitted underwear.
the relationship between fabric properties and Clothing pressure of knitted underwear.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fabric property is the key factor which influence the clothing pressure of knitted underwear.
Clothing Pressure of underwear was negative correlation of fabric elastic recovery rate, and was positive of tensile stretch rate, and was also negative of tensile strength.
the fabric with high elasticity and high tensile stretch rate would have a low clothing pressure, and the fabric with low elasticity and low tensile stretch rate will have a high clothing pressure.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the clothing pressure of knitted underwear is related to the fabric property, especially the fabric elasticity, and the clothing pressure of underwear can be controlled by fabric property.

the Clothing Pressure of knitting underwear could be reduced by using the fabric with high tensile stretch rate and high elastic recovery rate. Proc.
